title: Basic adjustments and histogram — proposed JPEG tool slices
objective: Deliver a useful exact-output histogram and Exposure slice, followed by core Tone, White Balance and Color controls with shared UI/API history and bounded processing.
context_summary: Product choices are decided (JPEG first, one fixed-order Basic layer, release commits, global tone first, Lightroom research as the numerical starting point, Slice A before Slice B); implementation was authorized on 2026-09-21 and runs against the design's integration contract. The delivered baseline is M3 modules, M4 crop drafts and conflicts with number parameters and in-place layer updates, content-space edits, the orientation layer and the Develop workspace whose generated tools panel already renders sliders that commit once on release. Still missing in the core: the revision-bound draft lifecycle, bounded pointwise float colour processing with point sampling, the histogram analysis job and the field-patch action. No export, RAW, PNG, HDR, Auto, external loader or local-presence implementation is added. Every crates handoff answers the performance checklist and measures photo-sized inputs.
